name: Open Web Analytics Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free GPL-2.0-or-later self-hosted web analytics server for unlimited websites, pageviews, events, e-commerce tracking and reporting; no vendor-imposed software analytics quota.
watch_out: You must host and maintain the PHP application and database, secure admin access, configure privacy/consent and cookie retention as applicable, and comply with GPL obligations for redistribution. Infrastructure and maintenance costs are not included.
